beliefs: f applies a uniform +2 ASCII shift to every character, including letters, digits, punctuation, space, and high characters [E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6]
Lowercase letters cross into punctuation: y->{, z->| [E5]
Uppercase letters cross into punctuation: Z->\, Y->[ [E2, E4]
Space becomes $ and punctuation shifts by +2 (e.g. !->%, ~->\u0082) [E2, E3, E4, E6]
Characters near DEL shift past it: \u007f->\u0081, \u0080->\u0082 [E6]
notes: The uniform +2 shift was already correct in principle; my earlier predictions were wrong because I had mistakenly applied class-specific wrapping in the code. E6 confirms space->$, ~->\u0082, and DEL/high chars shift by +2 with no wrapping.
